quotes.text: The only way we can achieve true American Energy Dominance is when we utilize all-of-the-above forms of energy to include Montana's clean coal. Coal provides reliable, abundant and affordable baseload power. Our economy and people have always relied on Montana's clean coal and that is only going to increase with the advancement of AI, data centers and population growth,
Our economy runs on reliable, abundant, and affordable power, and that need will only grow with increased demand from AI and data centers.
